points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 墨子出生于鲁国（今山东一带），早年曾学习儒家思想，但后来对儒家繁琐的礼制和等级制度产生不满。他出身工匠阶层，精通机械制造和建筑工程，这为他后来的工程技术思想奠定了基础。在鲁国期间，墨子开始形成自己独特的哲学思想，强调实用主义和功利主义，反对不切实际的空谈。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the State of Lu (modern-day Shandong), Mozi initially studied Confucian thought but later became dissatisfied with its elaborate rituals and hierarchical system. Coming from a craftsman background, he mastered mechanical engineering and architecture, which laid the foundation for his later technical philosophy. During his time in Lu, Mozi began to develop his unique philosophical ideas, emphasizing pragmatism and utilitarianism, and opposing impractical theoretical discussions.

points.title: 创立墨家
points.description: 在宋国期间，墨子正式创立了墨家学派，提出了"兼爱"、"非攻"、"尚贤"、"尚同"等核心思想。他组织了一个纪律严明的学术团体，成员多为工匠和下层知识分子，强调实践和行动。墨家学派发展迅速，成为与儒家齐名的显学。墨子亲自带领弟子参与各种实践活动，包括防御工程的设计和建造，以及调解诸侯国之间的冲突。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in the State of Song, Mozi formally established the Mohist school of thought, proposing core ideas such as 'universal love' (jian'ai), 'against aggression' (feigong), 'elevation of the worthy' (shangxian), and 'conformity to the will of heaven' (shangtong). He organized a disciplined academic group, mainly consisting of craftsmen and lower intellectuals, emphasizing practice and action. The Mohist school developed rapidly, becoming as influential as Confucianism. Mozi personally led his disciples in various practical activities, including designing and building defensive engineering projects and mediating conflicts between feudal states.

points.title: 止楚攻宋
points.description: 墨子得知楚国准备攻打宋国后，不顾个人安危，从鲁国步行十日十夜赶到楚国都城。他通过九次与公输班的辩论，从道义、实用和军事技术等多个角度说服楚王放弃攻宋计划。墨子还当场演示了守城技术，展示了他的防御器械和战术。这一事件充分体现了墨子"非攻"思想的实践性，也彰显了他不畏强权、勇于和平调解的精神。
points.descriptionEn: When Mozi learned that the State of Chu was planning to attack Song, he disregarded personal safety and walked for ten days and nights from Lu to Chu's capital. Through nine debates with Gongshu Ban (Lu Ban), he persuaded King of Chu from multiple perspectives—moral, practical, and technical—to abandon the attack plan. Mozi also demonstrated defensive technologies on the spot, showcasing his defensive weapons and tactics. This incident fully embodied the practical nature of Mozi's 'anti-aggression' philosophy and demonstrated his courage in standing against power and mediating for peace.

points.title: 游说诸侯
points.description: 在齐国期间，墨子积极游说各国诸侯，推行他的政治主张。他向齐王阐述"尚贤"的重要性，主张任人唯贤而非唯亲；他反对奢侈浪费，提倡节俭；他强调国家间的和平共处，反对侵略战争。墨子的游说虽然未能完全改变当时的政治格局，但他的思想在诸侯国间产生了广泛影响。同时，墨家学派在齐国也得到了进一步发展，培养了众多弟子。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in the State of Qi, Mozi actively traveled among feudal lords to promote his political ideas. He explained to the King of Qi the importance of 'elevation of the worthy' (shangxian), advocating for appointment based on merit rather than favoritism. He opposed extravagance and promoted frugality, and emphasized peaceful coexistence between states while opposing aggressive wars. Although Mozi's persuasion did not completely change the political landscape of the time, his ideas had widespread influence among the feudal states. Meanwhile, the Mohist school further developed in Qi, cultivating numerous disciples.

points.title: 晚年传道
points.description: 晚年，墨子继续周游列国，传播墨家思想。他整理了自己的著作，形成了《墨子》一书，系统阐述了墨家的哲学、政治、军事和科技思想。墨子特别重视科学技术的应用，他在光学、力学、数学等领域都有深入研究，并将其应用于实际工程中。这一时期，墨家学派达到了鼎盛，成为战国时期最具影响力的学派之一。墨子的弟子们继承了他的思想，继续在各国传播和实践墨家理念。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Mozi continued to travel among various states, spreading Mohist thought. He organized his writings into the book 'Mozi', systematically expounding Mohist philosophy, politics, military strategy, and technology. Mozi placed special emphasis on the application of science and technology, conducting in-depth research in optics, mechanics, and mathematics, and applying them to practical engineering. During this period, the Mohist school reached its peak, becoming one of the most influential schools during the Warring States period. Mozi's disciples inherited his ideas and continued to spread and practice Mohist principles throughout the states.

appraisal.zh: 墨子是中国古代重要的思想家，所创墨家与儒家并称显学，构成先秦哲学的重要部分。他代表平民阶层，兼爱超越了爱有差等的观念，非攻彰显和平理念，在光学、力学与逻辑学上的成就尤为突出，其科技理性主义传统影响深远。另一种看法认为，兼爱忽视人性差异与社会现实，非攻在战国乱世不合时宜，墨家强调集体与纪律或压抑个体，对礼制的批判过于绝对，学派后来的衰落也反映了其局限。
appraisal.en: Mozi was an important ancient Chinese thinker whose Mohist school, alongside Confucianism, was known as one of the prominent schools and formed a vital part of pre-Qin philosophy. Representing the common people, his universal love transcended graded love, his anti-aggression stance embodied pacifism, and his achievements in optics, mechanics, and logic were especially outstanding, leaving a lasting tradition of technological rationalism. Another view holds that universal love overlooked human differences and social realities, that anti-aggression was ill-suited to the chaotic Warring States era, that Mohist collectivism and discipline may have suppressed individuals, and that his critique of ritual was too absolute; the school's later decline reflects its limitations.

supporter.zh: 墨子是中国古代伟大的思想家、科学家和和平主义者。他创立的墨家学派代表了平民阶层的利益，强调实用主义和功利主义，对后世产生了深远影响。墨子的'兼爱'思想超越了儒家'爱有差等'的观念，体现了平等博爱的精神；他的'非攻'主张彰显了和平主义理念；他在科学技术上的成就，尤其是光学和力学研究，领先世界两千多年。墨子不畏强权、勇于实践的精神，至今仍激励着人们。
supporter.en: Mozi was a great ancient Chinese thinker, scientist, and pacifist. The Mohist school he founded represented the interests of the common people, emphasizing pragmatism and utilitarianism, and had a profound impact on later generations. Mozi's concept of 'universal love' (jian'ai) transcended Confucian's graded love, embodying the spirit of equality and universal care; his 'anti-aggression' stance demonstrated pacifist ideals; his achievements in science and technology, particularly in optics and mechanics, were more than 2,000 years ahead of his time. Mozi's spirit of defying power and valuing practice continues to inspire people today.

critic.zh: 批评者认为墨子的思想过于理想化，在现实政治中难以实现。他的'兼爱'忽视了人性差异和社会现实，'非攻'主张在战国乱世中显得不合时宜。墨家学派强调集体主义和纪律性，可能压抑了个体的自由发展。此外，墨子对儒家礼制的批判过于绝对，忽视了传统文化中的价值。墨家学派后来衰落，也反映了其思想在复杂社会环境中的局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mozi's thoughts were too idealistic and difficult to implement in real politics. His 'universal love' overlooked human differences and social realities, while his 'anti-aggression' stance seemed inappropriate during the chaotic Warring States period. The Mohist school's emphasis on collectivism and discipline might have suppressed individual freedom. Furthermore, Mozi's criticism of Confucian rituals was too absolute, neglecting the values in traditional culture. The later decline of the Mohist school reflects the limitations of its ideas in complex social environments.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，墨子是中国古代重要的思想家，其思想与儒家并称'显学'，共同构成了先秦哲学的重要部分。墨家学派代表了中国古代科技理性主义的传统，在逻辑学、物理学等领域有独特贡献。在流行文化中，墨子常被塑造为和平使者、技术大师和反抗强权的象征。他的思想对现代环保主义、和平运动和科技伦理都有启示意义。墨子的生平和思想体现了中国古代多元文化并存的特点，是中国思想史上的重要篇章。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Mozi was an important ancient Chinese thinker whose philosophy, along with Confucianism, was known as one of the 'Two Great Schools' and constituted a vital part of pre-Qin philosophy. The Mohist school represented the tradition of ancient Chinese technological rationalism, making unique contributions to logic, physics, and other fields. In popular culture, Mozi is often portrayed as a peacemaker, technical master, and symbol of resistance against power. His ideas offer insights to modern environmentalism, peace movements, and technology ethics. Mozi's life and thought reflect the characteristic of diverse cultural coexistence in ancient China, representing an important chapter in Chinese intellectual history.

self.zh: 天下皆白，唯我独黑；天下皆黑，唯我独白。
self.en: When the world is all white, I alone am black; when the world is all black, I alone am white.
